title: Gangneung vs Sokcho: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Gangneung for beaches and coffee culture. Sokcho for Seoraksan hiking and authentic seafood. Do both in 3 days.

categories.name: Beaches
categories.summary: Gyeongpo Beach is longer, better developed, and backed by a scenic lagoon and pine forest.

categories.name: Hiking / Nature
categories.summary: Seoraksan National Park — Ulsanbawi Rock and Biryong Falls — is world-class hiking right on Sokcho's doorstep.

categories.name: Food Scene
categories.summary: Gangneung wins for Chodang tofu; Sokcho wins for Abai Village sundae and seafood market.

categories.name: Coffee Culture
categories.summary: Gangneung Coffee Street is one of Korea's top food/drink destinations.

categories.name: Transport from Seoul
categories.summary: KTX direct in 2h10m vs Sokcho's 2.5–3h bus.

categories.name: Budget
categories.summary: Both cheap vs Seoul, Sokcho slightly cheaper overall.

categories.name: City Amenities
categories.summary: Larger city (220k vs 82k), more restaurant and shopping variety.

faq.question: Is Gangneung or Sokcho better for a weekend trip from Seoul?
faq.answer: Gangneung for beaches and coffee; Sokcho if Seoraksan hiking is the main goal.

faq.question: How far apart are Gangneung and Sokcho?
Should I visit both?
faq.answer: Yes — a 3-day Seoul → Gangneung → Sokcho → Seoul loop is one of Korea's best trips.
